Survey title: Enquête nutritionnelle anthropométrique et de mortalité rétrospective SMART 2024 - Mali (14e édition), rapport final
Lead organization: Institut National de la Statistique (INSTAT) / DGSHP - Sous-Direction Nutrition (with UNICEF, WFP, WHO, FAO)
Geographic coverage: National, 9 regions + Bamako district; Kidal and Ménaka limited to the towns (insecurity)
Notes: Final report dated November 2024 (file named "Mali 2025" but it is the 2024 survey). No combined GAM table. National severe underweight taken from summary Tableau 1 (garbled cell in Tableau N3). Morbidity without CI; "toux" column coded COUGH. Mortality recall 90 days in the text, "four months" in summary Tableau 1.
